# Group generated by sign reversal and reciprocation

↑ **Parent:** [Klein four-group](klein-four-group.md)

On the nonzero real numbers, sign reversal $a$ and reciprocation $b$ are commuting [involutions](involution.md). Their [function composition](function-composition.md) generates exactly $e(x)=x$, $a(x)=-x$, $b(x)=1/x$ and $ab(x)=-1/x$. The relations $a^2=b^2=e$ and $ab=ba$ identify the [group](group-split.md) with $C_2\times C_2$, the [Klein four-group](klein-four-group.md). Its subgroups are the trivial group, its three order-two cyclic subgroups and itself. Excluding zero from the domain is necessary for all four transformations to be defined and invertible.
